CollectionReadinessDTO.description:
AI-1 control-plane readiness folded into the admin view: whether the
collection pipeline is actually runnable (sampling driver + reservation
reaper wired, no unresolved surface substitution, scheduler up). Composed by
the integrator from AI-1's scheduler_wiring.check_readiness() +
registry.readiness() and injected via collection_readiness_provider.
Unwired / exception / attention_required never reads 'ready'.
CollectionReadinessDTO.title: CollectionReadinessDTO

PublicBaselineResponseDTO.description:
Public baseline never silently falls back; it explicitly reports whether
the k-anonymity gate is met and the ACTUAL scope used.
PublicBaselineResponseDTO.title: PublicBaselineResponseDTO

PublicOpportunitiesResponseDTO.description:
